script: In a king's court, a scholar pushed a sage: how many gods are there? Three thousand three hundred and six. Yes, but how many, really? Thirty-three. Really? Six. Three. Two. One and a half. Really? One. All the gods are faces of that one. An old verse says it in five words: truth is one, the wise call it by many names. So Hindus can love many gods, and still mean one. And most have one face of God that feels like home. That one is yours.
